_doc: Rules for scripts/audit_filings.py. Edit this file (not the script) when a company's fiscal year, SEC code or a known not-filed period changes. Every exemption MUST carry a reason.
_fiscal_doc: Default fiscal year = calendar year (fye_month 12). label 'end' = FY named after the calendar year it ENDS in (AOT FY2024 = Oct 2023-Sep 2024); 'start' = named after the year it STARTS in (AEONTS FY2024 = Mar 2024-Feb 2025). Derived from the due_date column of filings-index.
_sec_code_doc: Extra SEC company codes (the 4 digits after dat/news/YYYYMM/ in FILEID) that are legitimate for a ticker, e.g. a pre-merger entity.
_name_doc: Extra strings that identify the company inside a document (checked case-insensitively, in addition to companies.js nameFull and the ticker).
_exempt_doc: Slots that legitimately have no filing. Key = TICKER, value = list of {year, period?, type?, reason}. Omitted period/type = all.

AXTRART.reason: app status=not_applicable (no Q1-Q3 2024 filing for the new entity)
